name: com.birchgames.projectdesigner
description: A node-based pre-production planner for indie Unity teams with built-in planning workflows, reference capture, technical design support, and public extension hooks.

samples.description: Built-in showcase content, including the Project Designer+ Redo demo board for inspecting planner depth, launch prep, and package architecture in context.
A sample custom node, inspector, asset importer, and demo planning board built on top of the Project Designer+ registry.
